title: Service deploy manifest (infra/services/<service>/deploy.yaml)
description: What to deploy where, and which secrets it needs. Read by infra/deployment/deploy.sh, deploy-target.sh and OpenTofu (infra/secrets-manager/tofu/services.tf). Spec: docs/specs/deployer.md (D12).

host.description: SSH alias of the target host (~/.ssh/config).

wave.description: Pipeline deploy order (deployer spec D19): wave 1 = services (in parallel), wave 2 = the edge (api-service), after wave 1 succeeded.

pipeline.description: true: GitHub Actions may deploy it through the deployer. false: by hand only (deploy.sh), e.g. the roots of trust (deployer spec D13, D16).

code.description: The service's code folder. With python/libs/, the image's inputs: the image is named by the last commit that changed them (deployer spec D1a).

compose.description: Compose file; its service name must equal `service`.

health.description: Checked by name over TLS after the container is healthy.

secret.description: Optional: host path of a secret the test needs, mounted at /t/secret (e.g. the smoke-test client secret, delivered from OpenBao).

pre_start.description: Sourced by deploy-target.sh after the build, before the start.

to.description: Absolute path on the host; written with mode 600.

format.description: Text written to the file; {value} is replaced by the secret.

host_only.description: Paths created on the host and never delivered or copied (checked to exist).
